legacyparkourcompat.version.title: Movement Version
legacyparkourcompat.version.description: Pick a version from the list, or type a ParkourVersion id. Turn legacy movement off to use current vanilla physics.
legacyparkourcompat.version.status.disab: Legacy movement is off. Current vanilla physics are used.
legacyparkourcompat.version.status.unimp: %s is a ParkourVersion, but no movement changes are implemented yet.
legacyparkourcompat.version.status.inval: Not a ParkourVersion. Use an id from the list (for example 1.8.9).
legacyparkourcompat.message.forced: Forced parkour version to %s to match the server.
legacyparkourcompat.disconnect.version_m: Your Minecraft version (%s) does not match this server's parkour version (%s). Install Legacy Parkour Compat, or connect with a matching client.
